1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 Bc5 4.O-O Nf6 5..strategy: Prepares the central break d4 with a pawn behind it: if Black takes on d4, the recapture with the c-pawn hits the bishop on c5 and leaves White a broad centre. It also gives the c4-bishop the b3 and c2 squares to retreat to. The price is time: this is a slow manoeuvring game.

Strikes in the centre before White can build with d4, and the pawn attacks the c4-bishop with tempo. Black accepts an open game in return for active pieces and a share of the centre, while White has to decide how to resolve the tension and where the bishop belongs.
